description.content:
Get the direct (1-hop) neighbors of a specific asset.

Returns the asset, its immediate upstream and downstream dependencies,
and the dependency edges between them. Does not traverse transitive
dependencies.

query.description: (Required) The asset key to get neighbors for

description.content:
Get historical materializations for a specific asset.

Returns one materialization per run (deduplicated by run_id, latest occurred wins).

query.description: (Required) The asset key to get materializations for
Only return materializations on or after this timestamp
Only return materializations on or before this timestamp

description.content:
Get downstream assets that reference (consume) a specific asset.

Returns materializations of assets that have the queried asset in their
upstream dependencies. Deduplicated by run_id (latest occurred wins).

query.description: (Required) The asset key to get references for
Only return references on or after this timestamp
Only return references on or before this timestamp

description.content:
Get a specific downstream consumer by its event ID.

Returns the materialization event for an asset that consumes the queried upstream
asset. The upstream asset key must be provided and must appear in the
materialization's upstream dependencies.
